basis: Muscular dystrophy with defining developmental impairment and seizures; cataract and cardiomyopathy each reported in 1/3. Respiratory weakness does not establish lung damage.
Inherited erythroid marrow failure causes macrocytic anemia; congenital cardiac anomalies lack evidence of frequency above 30%.
Carcinoma arises at the biliary-duodenal ampulla, with explicit duodenal and extrahepatic bile-duct ancestry. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine disease.
Hypogonadism, intellectual disability and congenital vertebral/rib anomalies define the syndrome; diabetes also falls within the endocrine axis.
Inappropriate breast milk secretion; breast has no axis. Hyperprolactinemia is a possible underlying diagnosis rather than an intrinsic feature of every case.
Melanoma originates in the uvea; tumor necrosis does not establish another organ axis.
Familial aneurysmal disease of the abdominal aorta.
Obstruction of dermal sweat ducts causes a primary skin disorder.
Defining dentin dysplasia affects teeth, and generalized long-bone osteosclerosis affects the skeleton; marrow narrowing alone does not establish blood dysfunction.
Inherited dental enamel hypocalcification; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Inherited impaired acetaldehyde metabolism defines the disorder. Flushing and nasal congestion are transient reactions without demonstrated organ damage.
Solitary fibrous tumor/hemangiopericytoma originates in the meninges.
CRYGD-related cataract directly affects the ocular lens.
Blepharophimosis affects eyelids and intellectual disability establishes neurodevelopmental involvement; both define the named syndrome.
Sex cord-stromal tumor of reproductive organs; endocrine hormone dysfunction is not inherent to the umbrella concept.
Penoscrotal hypospadias is a structural abnormality of the urethra, which belongs to the renal axis; reported in 4/4 patients.
Neoplasm originates in the small intestine; neuroendocrine differentiation does not itself establish endocrine gland disease or a functional hormonal syndrome.
Immunodeficiency with defining eczema; intellectual disability in 6/8. Pneumonia 2/11 and oral thrush 3/11 fall below threshold; recurrent otitis lacks demonstrated lasting damage.
Benign vascular tumor occupies the brain; no separate systemic cardiovascular damage is established.
Inherited chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis with chronic fungal nail infection; common damaging oral involvement is not established for this subtype.
Inherited apolipoprotein processing/aggregation disorder produces renal amyloid nephropathy. Common functional damage in other organs is not established.
Insufficient functional small intestine causes intestinal failure and malabsorption. Nutritional consequences do not establish a separate primary metabolic disorder.
Lymphocytic mastitis is an immune-mediated fibroinflammatory breast disorder. Breast has no structural axis; associated diabetes and thyroid disease are separate diagnoses.
Perineal hypospadias is reported in 80-99% and structurally affects the urethra. Mixed blood/immune lineages do not establish dysfunction; pigment patches do not establish skin damage.
Mitochondrial disease with defining neuropathy and intestinal failure; destructive myopathy in 2/2. Ophthalmoplegia reflects muscle dysfunction; hearing impairment is occasional.
